datasets.title: Geographic mapping of school locations in the Pacific
datasets.description: Schools in all Pacific Island Countries and Territories have been included in their respective Education Management Information Systems in 2015 by the Statistics for Development Division of SPC. This data can be used for applications such as disaster mitigation and optimise emergency response and service delivery. Access this dataset from the Pacific Data Hub. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/pdh-geographic-mapping-of-school-locations-in-the-pacific]

lineage.description: School location data were collected and integrated into national Education Management Information Systems by the Statistics for Development Division of the Pacific Community in 2015. The dataset comprises point geometries and tabular attributes (name, type, enrollment, authority) for educational facilities across 15 Pacific Island nations, structured as GeoJSON and CSV formats by country.

sources.name: SPC Statistics for Development Division (SDD)
sources.description: Census-based geographic inventory of school locations compiled into Education Management Information Systems across Pacific Island Countries and Territories in 2015
